author: Bereal2222
quote: I Played all GTA's since ps1 era. This game IS technically impressive. Its world is immersive and engaging.  The detail in graphics is amazing. It is not a GTA game. The freedom that has defined GTA for decades is absent here.  Freedom of choice is the DNA of what a gta game is. Plus it doesn't have its multi-player/online component? .its not a complete product.  Sadly. I don't recommend in its current iteration.

author: Bereal2222
quote: This game is a lot of fun. Takes a bit to get going but once it does it gets very intense. After about match 10ish things start to change up a lot. I think most of these low scores are people who invested little time into this game. Probably gave up after 4 or 5 matches. Its not the best game but dam I have not been able to put it down. I would suggest to give it a try and keep going till you get past that initial 10 or so matches when things change up. Looking forward to further content.

author: Bereal2222
quote: Amazing game. I don't get the hate, its in my top 5 games of all time now. I didn't spoil the game for myself before its release so maybe thats why I loved it. You definitely need to play this.
